_comment: Digital Asset Links for the Android TWA. Replace the fingerprint with the SHA-256 printed by `bubblewrap build` (or shown in PWABuilder), then copy this file to app/public/.well-known/assetlinks.json and deploy. It must be reachable at https://poetech.us/.well-known/assetlinks.json or the TWA shows a browser bar. Do NOT ship it live with the placeholder fingerprint.
